description: This Go source file defines a rule for matching Go struct field names with JSON field names, implementing the 'NamesMatch' API rule for Kubernetes API validation. It includes logic for validating naming conventions, handling special cases, and ensuring consistency between Go and JSON representations.

classes.name: NamesMatch
classes.description: Implements the APIRule interface to enforce naming conventions between Go struct fields and JSON field names.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the API rule, 'names_match'.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a given type to ensure its fields conform to naming rules; returns list of violating field names.
